name: Summit AZ - Rank Math Optimization Trackers 2026-09
body:
> Tracker · Summit Az · 2026-09-15

# Summary
Rollup of the September spreadsheets used to move every page's on-page SEO into Rank Math after the relaunch. Each draft sheet has a "YOUR DECISION" column; approved rows were applied in Rank Math and verified live.

# Files
- `Summit-AZ-Page-Tracker-2026-09-05.xlsx`: snapshot of 43 pages from the live database on Sep 5 (categories, sitemap, robots, word count). Noted the sitemap had served 73 dead Utah URLs and the Redirection plugin was silently disabled (25 inert rules).
- `Summit-AZ-OnPage-SEO-Tracker-2026-09-05.xlsx`: all 199 published pages and posts crawled Sep 5; checks whether the first focus keyword appears in H1, title, meta, slug and content, H1 count, word count; slugs are report only (never change).
- `Summit-AZ-RankMath-Title-Approvals-2026-09-05.xlsx`: 19 title fixes (missing brand suffix, "Summit Pros" and the Utah brand "Summit Plumbing" corrected to "Summit Plumbing Pros").
- `Summit-AZ-FocusKeyword-Map-2026-09-07.xlsx`: 42 rows proposing primary and secondary focus keywords per page, with intent, competing page and recommendation (legal, utility and orphan pages flagged).
- `Summit-AZ-Full-Content-Inventory-2026-09-07.csv`: about 257 URLs with status, focus keyword, index state, HTTP, redirects, robots, canonical and sitemap flags.
- `Summit-AZ-RankMath-Tracker-2026-09-15.xlsx`: 200 pages graded NOT OPTIMIZED / Needs fixes / Minor tweaks / Optimized / N/A, with GSC index status and live title and meta. On Sep 15: 83 optimized, 92 minor tweaks; 86 titles over 60 characters.
- `Summit-AZ-RankMath-Title-Keyword-Drafts-2026-09-15.xlsx` (37 rows), `Summit-AZ-RankMath-Keyword-Cleanup-Drafts-2026-09-15.xlsx` (97 rows) and `Summit-AZ-RankMath-Description-Drafts-2026-09-15.xlsx` (133 rows): the three draft batches.

# Decisions and status
- Applied Sep 15 (handoff): 29 titles, 91 keyword boxes and 122 meta descriptions. Keyword boxes cut from 7 to 10 auto-imported terms (often including the brand) to the relevant few; main keyword moved into titles and descriptions.
- Result per the work summary: fully optimized indexed pages rose from 4 to 78 of 176.
- Later: 31 titles shortened to 60 characters on Oct 16 (see [Summit AZ - Title Shortening and SEO Check 2026-10-16](lib:brain-summit-az-title-shortening-and-seo-check-2026-10-16)).
